headline: Two American Airlines Jets Clip Wings While Taxiing at Washington Airport
label: NEWS
caption:
Two American Airlines planes collided on the ground at a Washington airport, breaking the wing of one aircraft. ✈️

According to reports from Gulf News and UrduPoint, the incident occurred while the two Boeing aircraft were taxiing.

No injuries have been reported so far, and airport officials are currently looking into how the collision happened.
